verdict.rationale: Mercury Books supports rule-based automation like categorization rules, bulk GL code assignment, multi-layered bill approval rules, and automatic duplicate detection, plus continuous auto-categorization/reconciliation — but this is bank/transaction-triggered automation, not a general user-defined event-trigger-action rules engine, and the promised API/MCP layer for broader agent-driven automation is explicitly future ('soon'), not shipped. Missing for 10: a general-purpose custom trigger-action rules framework beyond categorization/approvals, shipped API/MCP for programmatic rule creation, and independent confirmation of these automation rules working in practice.
